parent_contract.relationship: 707-only calibration enrichment authorized by the parent's next-research-stage clause; no old Stage-A execution is revived

observed_before_freeze: the ten frozen 707-series discrete P1 quota artifacts and their structural-identifiability audit
the previously completed outcome-selected path-localization artifact and audit
CPU-only unit, mutation, and prefix-to-chunk1 smoke-test outputs
implementation source and static validation results
not_observed_before_freeze: any newly extracted full-forward FP32 score stream
any continuous pre-ceiling demand result from the ten frozen checkpoints
any new quality input, supervision value, prediction, or score
observation_boundary.adaptation_classification: design enrichment after a calibration-only structural tie diagnosis, not a confirmatory quality-effect analysis

adaptation_disclosure.reason_for_new_metric: Discrete ceil-and-quota aggregation left 10 of 20 seed-scale-budget mappings unidentifiable, including four fully tied score-demand pairs.
adaptation_disclosure.prior_information_used: Existing 707 calibration structures and the path-localization diagnosis were used to choose a richer target-free statistic and a two-path transfer gate.
adaptation_disclosure.interpretation: A pass establishes only calibration-layer rank feasibility; it cannot estimate adaptive quota, pin, or quality effects.

primary_statistic.query_level_formula: candidate_blocks == 0 ? 0 : min(candidate_blocks, max(min_blocks_per_layer, top_p_cardinality) + uncertainty * max_extra_blocks_per_layer)
primary_statistic.relationship_to_p1: exact continuous relaxation of the final per-query ceiling while retaining candidate clipping, the configured floor, and the original P1 signal recipe
primary_statistic.slice_statistic: exact empirical upper-five-percent mean with fractional boundary mass
primary_statistic.layer_statistic: equal-weight macro average of the 45 family-by-context slice statistics
primary_statistic.point_tie_policy: all exact point-score boundary ties remain unresolved

phase_1_full_forward.purpose: reproduce each frozen P1 calibration and determine whether the single primary continuous statistic identifies stable unique extremes
phase_1_full_forward.execution: the exact existing full-forward calibration collector, 256 examples per family and batch size four
phase_1_full_forward.reproduction_gate: the complete 1x, 2x, and 4x quota objects, calibration digests, signal configurations, workload counts, and checkpoint bindings must reproduce exactly

inference.resampling_unit: paired complete trace batch, sampled within each of 45 workload slices
inference.deterministic_stability_split: canonical trace-batch alternation A/B within every slice
required_checks: a unique point top and a unique point bottom
top-versus-adjacent and adjacent-versus-bottom point gaps exceed the frozen float32 tolerance
every paired 99-percent bootstrap lower bound is strictly positive
both deterministic A and B split differences are strictly positive

phase_1_full_forward.continue_gate: all 20 seed-scale-budget cells pass every check; otherwise Phase 2 is terminally blocked

phase_2_exact_path.purpose: test whether Phase-1 extremes transfer to the literal sequential-tiered runtime path without using any quality outcome
phase_2_exact_path.reference: budget-specific uniform-total fixed+pins, protected pins enabled, adaptive signals and dense fallback disabled
phase_2_exact_path.integer_schedule: canonical-index Bresenham low/high mixture across 45 slices, with exact aggregate configured-total equality to the calibrated mean
phase_2_exact_path.path: one full-model prefix forward followed by one-token full-model forwards through sequential tiering
phase_2_exact_path.coordinates: the first complete five-context cycle for each of nine frozen family streams
phase_2_exact_path.repeat_rule: forward and reverse are deterministic integrity repeats and are never uncertainty-resampling units

required_checks: canonical workload, semantic query, exact FP32 score, and demand-observation streams agree across orders
a unique top and bottom are identified above tolerance with strictly positive paired-slice 99-percent lower bounds
the exact-path top and bottom equal the corresponding Phase-1 top and bottom

phase_2_exact_path.terminal_gate: all 20 seed-scale-budget cells pass; a pass permits only design of a new rank-probe manifest, never its execution

integrity_and_stopping.artifact_publication: exclusive atomic hard-link publication under a new output root; existing cells are deep-validated before resume
integrity_and_stopping.deep_validation: Phase-1 statistics are recomputed from serialized target-free demand rows; Phase-2 observations are recomputed from serialized replay queries and canonical configurations
integrity_and_stopping.phase_1_failure: publish the terminal audit and stop before exact-path execution
integrity_and_stopping.phase_2_failure: publish the terminal audit and do not design or execute a quality probe under this contract
integrity_and_stopping.phase_2_success: a separate versioned manifest and fresh seed namespace are required before any mechanistic or quality probe

data_access_boundary.full_forward_artifact: target-free continuous demand rows plus exact query/FP32-score stream digests
data_access_boundary.exact_path_artifact: registered-position replay-query metadata, exact FP32 block scores, demand observations, and canonical workload digests

claim_boundary: This study can establish only target-free calibration-rank feasibility and path transfer.
It cannot identify an adaptive-quota magnitude effect, protected-pin effect, or quality effect.
It cannot support natural-language, larger-model, HBM, latency, throughput, tail-failure, or production claims.
A terminal no-go is informative design evidence and is not evidence that the population quality effect is zero.
